blocks.text: The later bill is $61.39 every month.
The first parcel is thirty one dollars and seventy six cents. The single parcel choice is the other line, and it is not the one marked.
The host is the shop you opened. No packing line is added. Cotton cord is not ticked. Graphite pencil, dozen is a single item unless the repeat stays marked.
The label count is the amount you receive.

product.description: The pencils are graphite, a dozen in a sleeve.
product.name: Graphite pencil, dozen

trick.evidence_text: The lower figure is only the first parcel. Later bills are $61.39 every month.
trick.instruction: Pick the single parcel line and turn the repeat off before you pay.
